contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy radiate, possibly of Tetricus I and dating to the period AD 271-274 (Reece period 13). SPES AVGG reverse depicting Spes advancing left, holding flower and hem of robe. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP[]. Reverse description: Spes advancing left, holding flower and hem of robe. Reverse inscription: [SPES] AVGG. Dimensions: diameter: 16.09mm; weight: 1.58g. Die axis measurement: 12
